name: AI Agent: Order Concierge
author: Knotarium
description: Showcases the AI Agent node: a bounded LLM tool-use loop whose tools are your own workflows. The agent reads a customer message, decides whether it needs to look up the order, calls the 'lookup_order_status' tool (a workflow), and writes a short status reply. SETUP: (1) enable the 'aiAgent' capability under Settings → Capabilities; (2) install the companion 'Tool: Order Status Lookup' template and publish it; (3) open the AI Agent node here and select that workflow under Tools (the binding ships with the name/parameters pre-filled, only the target workflow is left for you to pick). List only workflows you would let the incoming message invoke. Requires an AI provider under Settings → AI Provider.
